end.summary: Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
end.parentNote: Diya practised converting 4-digit number names to numerals, including 2,450 and 8,614, using place-value language. They also practised identifying the hundreds place. A mix-up remained: they treated a digit’s face value as its place value; this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask Diya to build numbers with thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones, then say each digit’s value.
